casiopea-constel-desc:
{{desc|name=Casiopea-Con§tel|url=https://github.com/hspencer/casiopea-constel}}

"con§tel" is the product name: keep the section sign (§) in place of the letter "s".
right-constel-annotate:
{{doc-right|constel-annotate}}
A passage (§) is a stretch of page text selected by a reader. To "code" a passage is to attach a concept to it (qualitative-analysis term).
constel-mark-label:
Accessible name of a highlighted passage. Parameters:
* $1 - comma-separated concept labels
constel-panel-close:
Label of the close button of con§tel popups.
{{Identical|Close}}
constel-suggestion-uses:
Number of passages using a suggested concept. Parameters:
* $1 - formatted number
* $2 - raw number, for PLURAL. § is the section sign; §§ its plural.
constel-form-title: Title of the form that creates a passage (§).
constel-form-submit: Submit button of the passage form.
constel-form-public-notice: Shown until the reader creates their first passage.
constel-form-variant-create:
Button to create a concept although similar ones exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the concept typed
constel-form-reload: Link to reload the page after it changed.
constel-detail-title: Title of the popup listing the passages at a point of the text.
constel-detail-mine: Marks a passage as the viewer's own.
constel-detail-by:
Author of a passage. Parameters:
* $1 - username
constel-detail-hidden-user: Author of a passage whose username is suppressed.
constel-detail-remove:
Label of the button that removes a concept from a passage. Parameters:
* $1 - concept label
constel-detail-add: Placeholder and label of the field to add a concept to a passage.
constel-detail-delete-confirm: Confirmation question before deleting a passage.
constel-trigger-label: Accessible name of the § button shown after selecting text. Mentions the keyboard shortcut.
constellation-summary: Intro shown at the top of [[Special:Constellation]].
constellation-empty: Shown when the map is empty.
constellation-counts:
Frequency of a concept. Parameters:
* $1 - number of passages
* $2 - number of pages
constellation-graph-label:
Accessible name of the graph. Parameters:
* $1 - number of concepts
constellation-node-label:
Accessible name of a concept in the graph. Parameters:
* $1 - concept
* $2 - passages
* $3 - pages
constellation-as-list: Summary of the text alternative of the graph.
constellation-scope: Label of the scope selector (everyone / mine).
constellation-threshold: Label of the minimum link weight.
constellation-edges: Label of the checkbox that shows the links.
constellation-lens: Label of the field that chooses whose themes colour the map.
constellation-link-coexcerpt:
Link in the text list. Parameters:
* $1 - concept
* $2 - weight
constellation-link-overlap:
Link in the text list. Parameters:
* $1 - concept
* $2 - weight
constellation-back-to-themes: Button that returns from a concept to the themes panel.
constellation-my-themes: Title of the viewer's themes panel.
constellation-themes-of:
Title of another reader's themes panel. Parameters:
* $1 - username
constellation-no-lens: Title of the panel when no lens is chosen.
constellation-in-themes: Heading: themes that contain the concept.
constellation-in-no-theme: The concept is in no theme.
constellation-theme-of:
A theme and its owner. Parameters:
* $1 - theme
* $2 - username
constellation-group-into: Accessible name of the theme selector.
constellation-group: Button that puts the concept into the chosen theme.
constellation-note-label:
Accessible name of a note. Parameters:
* $1 - theme
constellation-note-new: Placeholder of the new note field.
constellation-theme-new: Placeholder of the new theme field.
myconstel-status-anchored: The passage is located on the current text.
myconstel-status-lost: The passage could not be located after the page changed.
myconstel-where-valid: Link to the old revision of a lost passage.
log-name-constel:
{{doc-logpage}}
Name of the log of con§tel moderation.
logentry-constel-delete:
{{Logentry}}
Parameters:
* $4 - author of the passage
* $5 - the quoted passage
constellation-moderate: Heading of the moderation tools in the concept detail.
constellation-merge-into: Placeholder of the merge target field.
constellation-merge-confirm:
Confirmation. Parameters:
* $1 - absorbed concept
* $2 - kept concept
constel-mine-menu: User-menu item: show only the viewer's passages (§) on the page.
constel-everyone-menu: User-menu item: show everyone's passages (§) on the page.
constel-marks-menu: User-menu item: hide the passage marks.
constel-marks-show-menu: User-menu item: show the passage marks again.
constel-form-gloss-label: Label of the gloss field: the reader's comment or clarification on the passage.
prefs-constel:
{{optional}}
Heading of the con§tel section in the Appearance tab of preferences.
constel-pref-enabled-help: Help text of the preference toggle.
constellation-scope-mine: Scope option: only the viewer's passages.
constel-detail-save:
Single button that applies all pending changes to a passage (added/removed concepts, gloss).
{{Identical|Save}}
constel-detail-save-delete: The same button when all concepts were marked for removal: saving deletes the passage.
constellation-graph-label-3d:
Accessible name of the 3D graph. Parameters:
* $1 - number of concepts
constellation-link-copage:
Link in the text list: both concepts were annotated on the same page. Parameters:
* $1 - concept
* $2 - number of shared pages
constellation-autorotate: Checkbox: the 3D map rotates slowly by itself (off by default).
